title: Beans
description:
Walking through the world you might encounter some bean plants, breaking them will give you some beans that you can then replant to get more. You can either craft Bean Stew out of it which is slightly better then mushroom stew on the food side or craft them into Lesser Magic Beans, planting these will cause a bean stalk to emerge that will continue to grow till it hits a block. You can also quickly climb on it.

A magic bean acts like a lesser magic bean but it will continue to grow till the height limit breaking any blocks in its way. On top of it will also be a bean pod that drops random amounts of beans,iron,gold,diamonds and emeralds (and a Golden Egg) when you break it. Magic Beans can not be crafted or found in the world, they are only available in the creative menu.

properties.label: Wild beans
properties.value: Bean plants grow in the world; breaking one gives 1 bean (3 to 4 when fully grown)

properties.label: Lesser Magic Bean
properties.value: Crafted from 8 gold nuggets and a bean (see recipe)

properties.label: Bean Stew
properties.value: Restores 8 hunger, 0.6 saturation; the bowl is returned

properties.label: Bean Pod
properties.value: Also drops a Golden Egg (config GoldenEgg, default true)
